title: Ordinary-player planet landing and refusal atomicity

positive: A valid same-sector landing returns planet.land.success and persists landed planet state.
A successful landing consumes the selected canonical turn cost exactly once.
negative: Malformed, remote, unauthorized, defense-refused, zero-turn and persistence-failure attempts do not consume a turn or mutate landing state.
Responses, event journal entries and before/after database snapshots agree.
policy_gates: Edition-specific defense and turn-cost rules must come from V3-CAN-00.
This fixture does not decide whether insurance, market orders or harvest are canonical.

cases.purpose: malformed landing request preserves turn and state
ordinary player lands on an unowned same-sector planet
ordinary player relands on the same owned planet with one cost per request
remote landing preserves turn and state
foreign planet preserves turn and state
defense outcome may damage the ship and records events, but must not consume a turn or set landed state
database failure rolls back turn and landing mutation
